concerns.detail: KB-04 is a passing response under the v2 rubric: its complete D repeats trial C in another permitted axis, establishing C's 2-point balance criterion despite the short text under C. C supplement is explicit, giving at least 18/20 before any partial magnitude/direction credit. My score is 19/20. A failed-ablation expectation for KB-04 would contradict evidence-anywhere and equivalent-axes rules. Remove the repeated evidence from an ablation intended to lack C balance, or accept this case as a pass; do not suppress visible learner evidence.

C assigns 2 points jointly to magnitude/direction and initial velocity change with reason without specifying their internal split. KB-04 visibly establishes magnitude/direction in D but omits the braking interpretation for the original rightward motion. I split 1+1 and give 1. Its pass does not depend on this choice, because the complete alternative-axis balance plus supplement already give C=3 and total18.

The supplied ordinary goal B explicitly promises signed same-body sums, nonzero resultant direction, zero-sum rest/uniform motion and body-origin scaled arrows. KB additionally makes nonzero-force speed-change reasoning relative to initial velocity necessary in C/D. Those four core points are outside the supplied B wording: a response satisfying its expressly stated content can reach only16/20 without them. Add the qualitative change-of-velocity relation to the teaching scope or show it is established by a named prerequisite; the supplied definitions of B's prerequisites are not included, so that latter justification cannot be independently verified here. This is an additional demanded competence, not missing coverage of B's existing clauses.

German candidate description says determine die angepasste Haftreibung unterhalb, an und oberhalb der Grenze. Above the static limit there is no actual static friction capable of retaining rest; the English description correctly distinguishes determining below/at the limit from deciding that sticking fails. Task and rubric correctly handle this; revise the German short description to unterhalb und an der Grenze bestimmen, bei Ueberschreitung das Ende des Haftens begruenden.

KG-05 B claims shifted dashed auxiliaries are in the image, but actual G-no-D contains none. B core still has both correct physical component arrows; D graph earns0, consistent with actual evidence. Do not infer auxiliaries from the prose.

The unchanged solution's mittlere Kraftspitzen conflates mean force and peaks. At fixed impulse, longer duration lowers mean force; a reduced peak additionally needs a comparable force-time shape assumption. This is inherited text, not a defect introduced by the prerequisite-only change.

Additional mandatory speeding/braking transfer is not explicit in the supplied B description. KB-04 is a pass because the repeated D calculation is valid C evidence.

These match all ordinary-goal clauses. German assessment short description needs the localized above-limit correction.
